title: HeibruSMP
description: Vanilla-like Java & Bedrock SMP economy, and a friendly community!
body:
# The HeibruSMP
A vanilla-like Minecraft server supporting both Java and Bedrock Edition.

## Features
- 10,000-block world border
- Winners receive rewards next season
- `/rtp`, `/shop`, and `/sell`
- Full economy system

## Non-vanilla Features
1. 6-row Ender Chest
2. Invisibility hides nametags
3. Invisibility hides killer names in death messages
